content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-what-nobody-tells-you-9|Stripe Alternatives]]'s availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-explained-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to payment]] infrastructure designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-what-actually-12|google]] Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Lemon squeezy

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a framework that enables digital creators in restricted countries to sell their products without the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors. Platforms like Lemon Squeezy and PayPal often restrict access based on geographical location, leaving creators in the lurch. This infrastructure provides a foundation that allows complete ownership and control over digital sales, ensuring that creators are not dependent on external platforms that may suspend accounts or freeze funds.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce combines various free and open-source tools to create a seamless online store. It leverages services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, while backend logic can be managed with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This stack is integrated with NOWPayments for instant cryptocurrency transactions. This decentralized approach ensures that creators have full ownership of their data and can process payments without relying on traditional banks or payment services.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
No more account freezes – own your payment processing.
The Components That Make It Work Together

At the core of this infrastructure are several key components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the front-end for hosting digital products. The backend can be handled using tools like Supabase for order management and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Together, these components create a robust platform capable of handling multiple products and transactions while ensuring complete control and security for the creator.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your sovereign commerce stack, start by selecting the tools you want to use: GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. Next, configure your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Store your orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, and ensure your files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, launch your store and start selling your digital products without the constraints of traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can use sovereign commerce infrastructure to set up your own digital store. This approach utilizes tools like GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment processing, allowing you to retain control over your sales and data without relying on restricted platforms.
Sovereign infrastructure means full control over your sales.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital products without a Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy account, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). This stack provides a complete setup with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing, ensuring a smooth deployment. Check out more at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.

You can utilize sovereign commerce infrastructure by setting up your own online store using tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments. This allows you to bypass traditional payment restrictions and manage your sales independently.

PayPal may not be a viable option in these countries due to restrictions and the potential for account suspensions. It is better to use crypto payment solutions integrated into a sovereign commerce stack.
What are the risks of relying on platforms like PayPal?
Relying on platforms like PayPal can lead to account suspensions that may freeze your funds for extended periods without recourse. This risk makes independent infrastructure a safer choice.
What cryptocurrencies can I use for transactions?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including popular options like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins, providing flexibility for your digital transactions.
